Marco: Quick async — kernel batch + KV smoke. Ran a canary sweep. TL;DR: p95 up ~8% with batch>16. Sharing what I did / blockers / today.

Olivia: Ran microbench on canary & collected traces.
```bash
bench --model redwood-small --seq 1024 --batch 32
p50: 45ms
p95: 210ms (+8% vs baseline)
cpu: 72%
errors: 0
```
Olivia: Trace shows a spike in memcpy during slot handoff around step 3.

Ben: @Marco @Priya saw similar on my run. I'm digging into the slot allocator; maybe contention in arena free list. :eyes:

Priya: I'll toggle KV prefetch and eviction thresholds in a repro cluster. Trying --prefetch=false to isolate.

Marco: Thanks. No blockers other than timebox. Today I'll instrument kernel counters (slot_wait_us, memcpy_bytes) and add a tiny guard in allocator.

Olivia: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2487 — adds counter + opt-in flag `--cooperative-alloc`.

Ben: Will review shortly. Quick question in the PR about ordering of free-list locks.

deploy-bot: Canary job 9843 finished: 3 hosts, 1 failing (OOM on host-3), rolling back to v6.2. :warning:

Priya: OOM looks unrelated — I triggered an eviction stress test earlier on host-3.

Marco: Ok good note. Could everyone run one more perf sweep with batch=16 and batch=32 after PR lands? Leave results here.

Olivia: Will do this afternoon. :coffee:

Ben: On it — will post p50/p95 and heap stats.

Priya: Running now, ping if you want me to attach heap profiles.

Marco: Great. If no other blockers we'll sync tomorrow morning. Thanks all.
